well_posedness: the proposal as written transports the RESIDUAL into the item's level-0 frame and then quantises it with the SHARED level-1 codebook; the shared codebook has no fixed coordinates in an item-dependent frame, so that version is not well posed. The dual -- the codebook stays canonical and is transported INTO the item's frame -- is well posed and is what this probe measures.
transport_convention: the residual lives in the ORIGIN's tangent space, so it is transported FROM THE ORIGIN into the codeword's frame; the earlier probe transported it 'from x', which rotates it by the wrong gyration
